Lightweight, easy to move around. It washes well and the spinner is very powerful.
My suggestions are: do not put too much soap, it is not necessary . After your first wash, drain the water, and then fill the machine with water only again and let it run for a minute, and then drain again. That should help you get rid of the soap. If not, that means that you either put too much soap or you load is a bit big. In that case, just rinse it again. I do not run water while the spinner is active. I simply rinse my clothes twice in clean water in the same section where I washed them. At the second rinse I add softener. Then I drain the water and transfer clothes to the spinner. That's it. When it comes to items that are made of thin fabric, or are sensitive, even including men's dress shirts, always spin for two minutes first. Then take the items out to see if they are dry enough. If you let them spin too long, it might be a bit aggressive for the fabric. For towels I do five minutes.
Make sure that you clean the lint collector regularly. My only problem with the machine is that by time it started to fail to drain properly. Looks like the pump is not good anymore.
Do not overload the spinner. Just be patient and try to wash your laundry every other day, so it would not pile-up . That way you will not complain how your machine cannot wash a big load at once. :-)

So, I read all the previous reviews, but wanted some time with this first. It's an excellent washer/dryer and really helps with saving money in NYC/ not bringing my clothes to a drop off/pick up service. However, the one thing i realized is for 2 of my shirts, it stretched the collar out significantly. I'm not sure whether this was during the wash or the spin process. So I have been using the gentle cycle and have received great results.

Since this isn't an actual dryer, I also include 1/4 cup white vinegar when washing with the detergent and the fabric softener to keep the clothes soft. Here's my process:

1. Fill washer with water, clothes, detergent, and vinegar. Run for 15 minutes.
2. Drain & refill washer with water. Add fabric softener & 1/4 white vinegar. Run 15 minutes.
3. Place half the load in the dryer/spinner. I run water for 3 minutes while it spins in the spinner (for a final rinse), then reset for 5 minutes to let clothes dry.
4. Clothes are mostly dry and I hang them.

For those of you who are questioning the smell of vinegar, it dissipates : )

Hope this helps! Enjoy
